messages:
marta_cs: Emberfield just asked to onboard a custom 14B summarizer for clinical notes. They explicitly require PHI token redaction, KMS/HSM key wrapping, SOC2 evidence, and a p95 latency target <=200ms. Renewal is in two weeks so this is urgent and could affect renewal negotiation.
leah_pm: Copy that. @marta_cs please paste their exact security checklist and expected QPS. We need to surface renewal risk in the account health doc.
devon_se: Also need the model spec and a sample prompt bank + eval set. Are they asking for Private (VPC) or an on-prem bundle? HSM generally implies private deployment.
marta_cs: Customer note: "Onboard Ember-14B summarizer. Requirements: PHI redaction with auditable logs, KMS/HSM key wrapping, SOC2 attestation copy, p95 <=200ms for short summaries, 50 qps steady with 200 qps burst, support for canary rollouts and immediate rollback. Requesting enablement session next week."
sanjay_infra: @devon_se @leah_pm PHI + HSM => Private deployment recommended. Preliminary sizing for 50 steady qps (quantized 14B + KV cache): estimate 4xA10G with KV caching and autoscale for bursts. I'll validate memory/throughput numbers.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: DR-8721. CI checks pending. Link: https://deploys.internal/DR-8721
leah_pm: We should run a focused safety eval on their sample dataset (PII edge cases, redaction failure modes). @marta_cs can you ask them to provide the labeled eval set and the label schema by EOD Wednesday?
marta_cs: Will request eval set and prompt bank today, and ask for desired SLA language for renewal talks.
devon_se: Draft eval plan suggestion: (1) redaction coverage tests across entity types, (2) hallucination/regression tests on medical/legal prompts, (3) latency under sustained burst. Quick harness example:
```python
# local preprod harness
for p in prompts:
    r = client.generate(model=\"ember-14b-v1\", prompt=p)
    assert not contains_phi(r)
```
leah_pm: Add a renewal trigger: customer satisfaction < 4 after enablement or any safety regression flagged in ops console. We'll document that in account health and handoff to AM.
sanjay_infra: I'll produce an infra & cost delta estimate for private + HSM, plus lead time for provisioning HSM keys. ETA tomorrow noon.
marta_cs: Action items: I) collect eval set & prompt bank (marta_cs) II) infra & cost estimate (sanjay_infra) III) safety eval harness & test plan (devon_se) IV) schedule enablement & own renewal (leah_pm).
leah_pm: Scheduling a 30-min kickoff Tue 11am. I'll invite Emberfield CSM, their security lead, and our security reviewer.
marta_cs: Noted. I'll flag renewal risk in account health doc and brief the AM. :white_check_mark:
